name: game-story
description: Lesson scripts ("stories") for the games in ~/games: the schema-1 story format the engine's story runner plays (beats with cues, camera, spawns, actions, choices), the catalogue of per-algorithm act actions, and write/validate/outline/export of kind "story" packages, plus the spoken captions (the readable words of every text) every story must get from its captions task before it is finished.
